transactionbodycustomfield.description: The internal id of the Bin Transfer created by the last inventory_release call for this receipt. TEXT rather than a List/Record link on purpose: a transaction link field has to name a record type, and the useful answer to "which transfer released this?" is one id a user can paste into a URL or a search. The transfer itself carries the Middleware's request_uuid in its native external id, which is the duplicate guard.
